name: Droplets of Fire
body:
School transmutation [fire]; Level alchemist 5, arcanist/sorcerer/wizard 6, cleric/oracle 6, shaman 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (drops of blood)

EFFECT

Range touch
Targets some drops of caster’s blood
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none or Reflex half; see text; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell works as fire seeds, except it transmutes some drops of the caster’s blood into fiery projectiles or bombs.
